title: 塞布尔菲尔德 Halcyon 联合联动
instruction:
你是中士。 Desmond Iwuchukwu 正在为塞布尔菲尔德县治安官办公室准备季度清理审查。过去 14 个月内发生的六起商业入室盗窃案均被警员视为无关的非强制进入损失而分别结案，但报告指出，Halcyon Alarm & Monitoring 以及操作员记录的用户在每次损失发生前不久都取消了操作。 Solange Beaumont 上尉需要一个可以带到 DA 的综合案件关联数据包，并且她需要能够在不知道六个案件的情况下看到模式。来自`sablefield_halcyon_case_materials.docx`的作品，其中包含六份报告叙述、Halcyon 取消记录、账户比较材料以及可用的采访记录。准备 `sablefield_consolidated_linkage_packet.docx`、`sablefield_consolidated_linkage_packet.pdf` 和 `sablefield_linkage_index.xlsx`，并将所有三个文件写入您启动的工作目录的顶层，并使用这些文件名。文件包应提供简明的案例概述，识别六起事件中的每一起事件以及相应的警报帐户事件，列出将它们视为一个调查线索的事实依据，并包括对有取消活动但未报告损失的 Halcyon 帐户进行比较。
包括一个忠实来源的年表或展览，让读者可以追踪每个链接案例的事件、场所、损失窗口、帐户和取消。添加简短的方法和限制注释，解释如何处理重叠的记录、退休的辅助字段以及任何无法计算的比率或比率；不要将没有支持的推论变成事实。该电子表格是跨职能审核者的索引，因此请保持其事件和帐户参考与数据包一致，并使未解决或不可用的值与零明显区分。 Glassmere Components 和 Wrenfield Works 是所提供材料中的前提，并且不会添加此处不支持的事实、嫌疑人、动机或法律结论。保持数据包适合内部流通，保留使用引用或事实描述的原始来源措辞，并使 PDF 与 DOCX 实质上相同。

---

上面提到的文件在`references/`中：

- `references/sablefield_halcyon_case_materials.docx` — 单一提供的源，包含六个入室盗窃报告叙述、Halcyon 取消日志、帐户比较材料、访谈记录、源字段定义以及组装合并链接数据包所需的记录标识符。
将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：

- `sablefield_consolidated_linkage_packet.docx` — 用于监督和 DA 审查的完整书面合并案例链接包。 （仅使用所提供来源支持的事实。；包括概述、六案例关联演示、比较人群、年表或证据、方法和限制以及来源参考。；明确重复或重叠记录的处理、退休辅助字段和零分母。；不要添加未经支持的嫌疑人、动机、法律结论或捏造证据。）
- `sablefield_consolidated_linkage_packet.pdf` — 合并案例链接数据包的渲染 PDF 版本。 （与 DOCX 版本基本匹配。；以电子方式打印或审阅时，保持文本可搜索和可读。；保留六案例链接、比较人群、年代或展览，以及方法和限制说明。）
- `sablefield_linkage_index.xlsx` — 交叉引用六个事件、场所、Halcyon 帐户、取消事件和数据包引用的审阅者索引。 （使用忠实来源的事件、前提、帐户、日期、时间窗口和取消参考。；保持不可用或不可计算的值不同于零。；匹配每个事件和帐户参考的 DOCX 和 PDF。；包括记录重复、退休助手和零分母处理的可见注释或字段。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

SABLEFIELD COUNTY SHERIFF’S OFFICE
Case Materials: Halcyon Alarm & Monitoring Review | Compiled records extract
Internal working materials. This document compiles report narratives, vendor records, account comparison rows, and available interview notes for review.
1. Commercial Burglary Report Narratives
SC-24-0187  |  Glassmere Components
Report date: 14 Mar 2024.  Reported loss window: 13 Mar 2024, 22:30 – 14 Mar 2024, 05:45.  Deputies documented no forced entry. The reporting manager stated that eighteen precision carbide cutters were missing from a locked tool cage after the overnight loss window. Original disposition: unrelated no-forced-entry loss.
SC-24-0412  |  Wrenfield Works
Report date: 29 May 2024.  Reported loss window: 28 May 2024, 20:15 – 29 May 2024, 06:10.  Deputies documented no forced entry. The business reported two commercial welding leads and a Lincoln power source missing following the stated overnight window. Original disposition: unrelated no-forced-entry loss.
SC-24-0679  |  Northvale Fixture & Supply
Report date: 18 Jul 2024.  Reported loss window: 17 Jul 2024, 21:00 – 18 Jul 2024, 05:30.  Deputies documented no forced entry. Six boxed brass faucet assemblies were reported missing from the receiving area. Original disposition: unrelated no-forced-entry loss.
SC-24-0934  |  Calder Row Commercial Laundry
Report date: 03 Oct 2024.  Reported loss window: 02 Oct 2024, 23:10 – 03 Oct 2024, 06:00.  Deputies documented no forced entry. The owner reported a change-fund envelope containing $640 missing from the office safe. Original disposition: unrelated no-forced-entry loss.
SC-25-0116  |  Alder & Keene Electrical
Report date: 22 Jan 2025.  Reported loss window: 21 Jan 2025, 19:45 – 22 Jan 2025, 05:50.  Deputies documented no forced entry. Four spools of 500-foot copper THHN cable were reported missing during the reported loss window. Original disposition: unrelated no-forced-entry loss.
SC-25-0388  |  Morrowline Restaurant Equipment
Report date: 09 May 2025.  Reported loss window: 08 May 2025, 22:00 – 09 May 2025, 06:20.  Deputies documented no forced entry. One countertop commercial mixer and a carton of replacement compressor controls were reported missing. Original disposition: unrelated no-forced-entry loss.

CONSOLIDATED CASE LINKAGE PACKET
Sablefield County Sheriff’s Office | Halcyon Alarm & Monitoring review
Prepared by: Sgt. Desmond Iwuchukwu    Intended supervisory recipient: Capt. Solange Beaumont
Purpose and concise assessment
This packet consolidates six separately closed Sablefield County commercial-burglary reports for review as one investigative lead. Source facts show no-forced-entry losses at six premises and one Halcyon operator event, recorded as “USER CANCEL - authorized user requested cancellation,” within each corresponding reported loss window. These recurring, time-proximate pairings support further consolidated review; they do not identify a person, establish motive, prove common authorship, or make a legal determination.
Halcyon’s presence alone is not sufficient to link cases. The comparison population shows four other Halcyon accounts with user-cancel activity and no reported loss. The indicator presented here is the combination of the source-reported loss, the no-forced-entry observation, and a time-proximate user-cancel record, not vendor use by itself.

criteria.evidence: 文件系统和提交的文件名。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查确切的基本名称、扩展名和顶级位置。

original.criterion: All three required files are present at the top level with the exact requested filenames.
original.grader_hint: Check exact basename, extension, and top-level placement.

criteria.description: DOCX 将作为有效的可读文档打开，PDF 将作为有效的可读 PDF 打开。
criteria.grader_hint: 打开或解析这两个文件；拒绝损坏或空的工件。

original.criterion: The DOCX opens as a valid readable document and the PDF opens as a valid readable PDF.
original.grader_hint: Open or parse both files; reject corrupt or empty artifacts.

criteria.description: XLSX 将作为包含可提取单元格内容的有效工作簿打开。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用离线电子表格库打开并检查非空单元格。

original.criterion: The XLSX opens as a valid workbook with extractable cell content.
original.grader_hint: Open with an offline spreadsheet library and inspect non-empty cells.

criteria.description: 该数据包将此事确定为塞布尔菲尔德县警长办公室的综合审查，涉及 Halcyon 警报和监控。
criteria.grader_hint: 在提取的文本中搜索组织名称和综合审阅上下文。

original.criterion: The packet identifies the matter as a consolidated Sablefield County Sheriff's Office review involving Halcyon Alarm & Monitoring.
original.grader_hint: Search extracted text for both organization names and the consolidated-review context.

criteria.description: 该数据包标识了中士。 Desmond Iwuchukwu 担任审核发起人，Capt. Solange Beaumont 担任预期监督接受者。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证两个名称及其角色的属性是否正确。

original.criterion: The packet identifies Sgt. Desmond Iwuchukwu as the reviewing originator and Capt. Solange Beaumont as the intended supervisory recipient.
original.grader_hint: Verify both names and their roles are correctly attributed.

criteria.description: 该数据包为展开综合调查提供了明确、谨慎的基础，而不是断言不受支持的肇事者或法律结论。
criteria.grader_hint: 审查者应该能够将观察到的关联指标与假设和法律决定区分开来。

original.criterion: The packet gives a clear, cautious basis for opening one consolidated investigation rather than asserting an unsupported perpetrator or legal conclusion.
original.grader_hint: A reviewer should be able to distinguish observed linkage indicators from hypotheses and legal determinations.

criteria.description: 该数据包包含所有六个源事件标识符。
criteria.evidence: 与来源相比的六案例表或同等展示。
criteria.grader_hint: 比较事件标识符集，而不仅仅是计数。

original.criterion: The packet includes all six source incident identifiers.
original.evidence: Six-case table or equivalent exhibit compared with source.
original.grader_hint: Compare the set of incident identifiers, not just the count.

criteria.description: 该数据包准确包含六起入室盗窃事件源，并且不提供仅用于比较的账户作为其他入室盗窃事件。
criteria.grader_hint: 将事件与六个叙述进行核对，并检查标签以获取比较记录。

original.criterion: The packet contains exactly the six source burglary incidents and does not present comparison-only accounts as additional burglaries.
original.grader_hint: Reconcile the incident set against the six narratives and inspect labels for comparison records.

criteria.description: 第一个源事件的前提名称已准确复制。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查准确的前提字符串。

original.criterion: The first source incident's premise name is copied accurately.
original.grader_hint: Check exact premise string.

criteria.description: 第二个源事件的前提名称已准确复制。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查准确的前提字符串。

original.criterion: The second source incident's premise name is copied accurately.
original.grader_hint: Check exact premise string.

criteria.description: 第三源事件的前提名称已准确复制。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查准确的前提字符串。

original.criterion: The third source incident's premise name is copied accurately.
original.grader_hint: Check exact premise string.

criteria.description: 第四个源事件的前提名称被准确复制。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查准确的前提字符串。

original.criterion: The fourth source incident's premise name is copied accurately.
original.grader_hint: Check exact premise string.

criteria.description: 第五源事件的前提名称被准确复制。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查准确的前提字符串。

original.criterion: The fifth source incident's premise name is copied accurately.
original.grader_hint: Check exact premise string.

criteria.description: 第六源事件的前提名称被准确复制。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查准确的前提字符串。

original.criterion: The sixth source incident's premise name is copied accurately.
original.grader_hint: Check exact premise string.

criteria.description: 六个数据包事件中的每一个都保留源报告日期。
criteria.evidence: 事件展示与六个来源叙述进行比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 比较每个事件日期对；不要仅仅因为正确的计数而奖励。

original.criterion: Each of the six packet incidents retains the source report date.
original.evidence: Incident exhibit compared with six source narratives.
original.grader_hint: Compare every incident-date pair; do not award for a correct count alone.

criteria.description: 六个数据包事件中的每一个都保留源丢失窗口而不改变其边界。
criteria.evidence: 事件展示与来源的比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查所有六个窗口的开始值和结束值。

original.criterion: Each of the six packet incidents retains the source loss window without changing its boundaries.
original.grader_hint: Check start and end values for all six windows.

criteria.description: 所有六起事件都被描述为消息来源的非强制进入损失，但没有将该观察结果转化为更强有力的、无证据支持的主张。
criteria.evidence: 六个事件摘要和来源叙述。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查每个案例的措辞和事实对应关系。

original.criterion: All six incidents are described as the source's no-forced-entry losses, without converting that observation into a stronger unsupported claim.
original.evidence: Six incident summaries and source narratives.
original.grader_hint: Check wording and factual correspondence for each case.

criteria.description: 六个数据包事件中的每一个都保留了其叙述中的重大报告丢失事实。
criteria.evidence: 事件摘要与来源叙述的比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 每个案例都必须附有其来源损失描述或准确简明的等效内容。

original.criterion: Each of the six packet incidents retains the material reported-loss fact from its narrative.
original.evidence: Incident summaries compared with source narratives.
original.grader_hint: Every case must carry its source loss description or an accurate concise equivalent.

criteria.description: 每个链接的事件都与源中正确的 Halcyon 帐户标识符配对。
criteria.evidence: 链接展示和XLSX与源日志的比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证所有六个事件帐户对。

original.criterion: Each linked incident is paired with the correct Halcyon account identifier from the source.
original.evidence: Linkage exhibit and XLSX compared with source log.
original.grader_hint: Validate all six incident-account pairs.

criteria.description: 每个链接的事件都与正确的 Halcyon 取消记录密钥配对。
criteria.evidence: 链接展示和XLSX与源日志的比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用源定义的密钥验证所有六个事件密钥对。

original.criterion: Each linked incident is paired with the correct Halcyon cancellation-record key.
original.evidence: Linkage exhibit and XLSX compared with source log.
original.grader_hint: Validate all six incident-key pairs using the source-defined key.

criteria.description: 每个链接的取消事件都使用正确的操作员事件时间戳进行复制。
criteria.evidence: 数据包展示和索引与源相比。
criteria.grader_hint: 准确检查每个时间戳，包括日期和时间。

original.criterion: Each linked cancellation event is copied with the correct operator event timestamp.
original.evidence: Packet exhibit and index compared with source.
original.grader_hint: Check every timestamp exactly, including date and time.

criteria.description: 每个链接的事件都被识别为用户取消，使用源的操作员措辞或准确忠实的释义。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证所有六个记录的事件类型。

original.criterion: Each linked event is identified as a user cancel using the source's operator wording or an accurate faithful paraphrase.
original.grader_hint: Verify event type for all six records.

criteria.description: 每个链接的取消时间戳都落在其配对源丢失窗口的九十分钟内。
criteria.evidence: 源窗口和数据包/索引时间戳。
criteria.grader_hint: 独立计算所有六对的区间隶属度。

original.criterion: Every linked cancellation timestamp falls within ninety minutes of its paired source loss window.
original.grader_hint: Independently calculate interval membership for all six pairs.

criteria.description: 该数据包通过一起显示事件、前提、帐户、损失窗口、取消时间和链接状态或通过明确的交叉引用，使六种情况的关系可见。
criteria.grader_hint: 冷酷的读者必须能够追踪每一对完整的对，而无需从分散的散文中重建它。

original.criterion: The packet makes the six-case relationship visible by showing incident, premise, account, loss window, cancellation time, and linkage status together or through an unambiguous cross-reference.
original.grader_hint: A cold reader must be able to trace each complete pair without reconstructing it from scattered prose.

criteria.description: 该叙述解释了为什么仅共享 Halcyon 供应商是不够的，并使用比较群体将六对配对放在上下文中。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找常见供应商存在和更具体的取消时间模式之间的明确区别。

original.criterion: The narrative explains why the shared Halcyon vendor alone is not sufficient and uses the comparison population to place the six pairings in context.
original.grader_hint: Look for an explicit distinction between common vendor presence and the more specific cancellation-time pattern.

criteria.description: 该数据包报告由源得出的其他 Halcyon 帐户的数量，其中包含用户取消且未报告丢失。
criteria.evidence: 比较表和来源比较材料。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据不同的合格账户标识符重新计算计数；不计算事件或重复行。

original.criterion: The packet reports the source-derived number of other Halcyon accounts with user cancels and no reported loss.
original.evidence: Comparison table and source comparison material.
original.grader_hint: Recompute the count from distinct qualifying account identifiers; do not count events or duplicate rows.

criteria.description: 比较群体包括符合“无损失取消”定义的每个源帐户，并且没有链接的入室盗窃帐户。
criteria.grader_hint: 通过帐户标识符和源丢失状态检查包含和排除。

original.criterion: The comparison population includes every source account meeting the cancel-without-loss definition and no linked burglary account.
original.grader_hint: Check inclusion and exclusion by account identifier and source loss status.

criteria.description: 该数据包保留源定义的比较周期标签或日期。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查每个比较行的周期标签。

original.criterion: The packet preserves the source-defined comparison-period labels or dates.
original.grader_hint: Check every comparison row's period label.

criteria.description: 该数据包保留比较记录的源帐户标签。
criteria.grader_hint: 比较帐户标签和标识符，而不仅仅是行数。

original.criterion: The packet preserves the source account labels for the comparison records.
original.grader_hint: Compare account labels and identifiers, not merely the number of rows.

criteria.description: XLSX 比较总体与数据包的比较总体一致。
criteria.evidence: XLSX 和 DOCX/PDF 比较展品。
criteria.grader_hint: 帐户标识符和状态必须保持相等。

original.criterion: The XLSX comparison population agrees with the packet's comparison population.
original.grader_hint: Set equality must hold for account identifiers and statuses.

criteria.description: 数据包的六个事件标识符与 XLSX 事件索引一致。
criteria.grader_hint: 比较完整的六项标识符集。

original.criterion: The packet's six incident identifiers agree with the XLSX incident index.
original.grader_hint: Compare the complete six-item identifier set.

criteria.description: 每个 DOCX/PDF 事件帐户配对都与相应的 XLSX 行一致。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查所有六对。

original.criterion: Every DOCX/PDF incident-account pairing agrees with the corresponding XLSX row.
original.grader_hint: Check all six pairs.

criteria.description: 每个 DOCX/PDF 取消时间戳均与相应的 XLSX 行一致。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查所有六个时间戳。

original.criterion: Every DOCX/PDF cancellation timestamp agrees with the corresponding XLSX row.
original.grader_hint: Check all six timestamps.

criteria.description: PDF 在六个事件行和比较结果上与 DOCX 基本相同。
criteria.evidence: 提取的 DOCX 和 PDF 文本。
criteria.grader_hint: 比较标准化文本和表格内容，仅允许分页或呈现差异。

original.criterion: The PDF is substantively identical to the DOCX on the six incident rows and comparison results.
original.grader_hint: Compare normalized text and table content, allowing only pagination or rendering differences.

criteria.description: 使用源定义的取消记录键对重复或重叠的取消记录进行一次计数。
criteria.evidence: 数据包/索引链接行和方法注释与源。
criteria.grader_hint: 基于密钥的重复数据删除后重新计算事件和帐户计数。

original.criterion: The repeated or overlapping cancellation records are counted once using the source-defined cancellation-record key.
original.evidence: Packet/index linkage rows and methods note versus source.
original.grader_hint: Recompute event and account counts after key-based de-duplication.

criteria.description: 方法注释指出了用于重复删除重叠取消行的确切源定义键。
criteria.grader_hint: 注释必须命名键或其组成字段，而不仅仅是说重复项已被删除。

original.criterion: The methods note states the exact source-defined key used to de-duplicate overlapping cancellation rows.
original.grader_hint: The note must name the key or its constituent fields, not merely say duplicates were removed.

criteria.description: 最终联动索引中不会将重复的取消记录显示为第二联动事件。
criteria.grader_hint: 计算不同的源键并与显示的链接事件进行比较。

original.criterion: No repeated cancellation record is displayed as a second linked event in the final linkage index.
original.grader_hint: Count distinct source keys and compare with displayed linked events.

criteria.description: 方法注释通过名称或明确无误的源标签来标识已退休的帮助器列。
criteria.evidence: 方法和局限性注释与来源相比。
criteria.grader_hint: 需要实际的辅助字段标签，而不是一般提及过时的列。

original.criterion: The methods note identifies the retired helper column by name or unmistakable source label.
original.evidence: Methods and limitations note compared with source.
original.grader_hint: Require the actual helper-field label, not generic mention of a stale column.

criteria.description: 该数据包表明，已退休的助手值未用于建立任何事件、帐户、计时或比较关系。
criteria.evidence: 方法注释和链接/索引内容。
criteria.grader_hint: 将结论追溯到当前权威领域；过时的辅助值不得控制输出。

original.criterion: The packet demonstrates that the retired helper values were not used to establish any incident, account, timing, or comparison relationship.
original.grader_hint: Trace conclusions to current authoritative fields; stale helper values must not control the output.

criteria.description: XLSX 明显地将已退休的帮助程序字段标记为已忽略、已退休或非权威。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿标题、注释或方法区域。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查可见的工作簿内容，而不是隐藏的元数据。

original.criterion: The XLSX visibly labels the retired helper field as ignored, retired, or non-authoritative.
original.evidence: Workbook header, note, or methods area.
original.grader_hint: Inspect visible workbook content, not hidden metadata.

criteria.description: 零分母源行被保留或显式表示为不可计算，而不是默默地省略。
criteria.evidence: 数据包比较/速率展示和 XLSX。
criteria.grader_hint: 找到分母为零的源行并验证相应的可见处理。

original.criterion: The zero-denominator source row is retained or explicitly represented as not calculable rather than silently omitted.
original.grader_hint: Locate the source row with denominator zero and verify a corresponding visible treatment.

criteria.description: 方法注释明确说明了为零分母选择的约定。
criteria.grader_hint: 读者必须找到一个明确的约定，而不是一个未解决的问题。

original.criterion: The methods note explicitly states the convention chosen for a zero denominator.
original.grader_hint: A reader must find a definite convention, not an unresolved question.

criteria.description: 零分母约定在数据包和 XLSX 中一致应用。
criteria.evidence: 对可交付成果进行评级/比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查相同的源行和每个输出出现。

original.criterion: The zero-denominator convention is applied consistently in the packet and XLSX.
original.grader_hint: Check the same source row and every output occurrence.

criteria.description: 没有为零分母行提供虚构的数值比率。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受明确标记的不可计算的表示；拒绝不支持的数字替代。

original.criterion: No fabricated numeric rate is supplied for the zero-denominator row.
original.grader_hint: Accept a clearly marked non-calculable representation; reject an unsupported numeric substitute.

criteria.description: 该数据包包含识别所提供案例材料文档的来源或材料注释。
criteria.evidence: 来源注释或参考文献部分。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查源文件名或明确的等效文件名。

original.criterion: The packet includes a source or materials note identifying the supplied case-materials document.
original.grader_hint: Check the source filename or an unambiguous equivalent.

criteria.description: 该数据包以跨职能内部阅读器可用的方式区分源事实、分析链接指示符和限制。
criteria.grader_hint: 审稿人不必推断哪些陈述是观察结果，哪些是结论。

original.criterion: The packet distinguishes source fact, analytical linkage indicator, and limitation in a way usable by a cross-functional internal reader.
original.grader_hint: A reviewer should not have to infer which statements are observations versus conclusions.

criteria.description: 六个案例的展览具有可读性，允许冷漠的读者追踪每个完整的联系，而无需搜索不相关的散文。
criteria.grader_hint: 判断易读性、标签的稳定性以及所有字段是否按案例对齐。

original.criterion: The six-case exhibit is readable and permits a cold reader to trace each complete linkage without searching through unrelated prose.
original.grader_hint: Judge legibility, stable labels, and whether all fields are aligned per case.

criteria.description: 该数据包并未断言所提供来源中不存在的指定嫌疑人、动机或法律调查结果。
criteria.evidence: 与源代码相比的完整数据包文本。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找不受支持的添加内容，而不仅仅是省略内容。

original.criterion: The packet does not assert a named suspect, motive, or legal finding absent from the supplied source.
original.evidence: Full packet text compared with source.
original.grader_hint: Look for unsupported additions, not merely omissions.

criteria.description: 数据包的源引用或引用的操作符描述与提供的措辞相匹配。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用引号时，需要准确的来源措辞。

original.criterion: The packet's source quotations or quoted operator descriptions match the supplied wording.
original.grader_hint: Where quotation marks are used, require exact source wording.

criteria.description: 三个可交付成果均不包含 #REF!、#DIV/0! 或 #VALUE!文本或公式错误。
criteria.evidence: 提取的文本和工作簿公式/错误检查。
criteria.grader_hint: 搜索所有可见和公式结果单元格以及所有提取的文档文本。

original.criterion: None of the three deliverables contains #REF!, #DIV/0!, or #VALUE! text or formula errors.
original.evidence: Extracted text and workbook formula/error inspection.
original.grader_hint: Search all visible and formula-result cells and all extracted document text.

criteria.description: XLSX 包含六个链接案例中每一个的行或记录，并且没有由副本创建的额外链接案例行。
criteria.grader_hint: 比较唯一的事件标识符和源定义的取消键。

original.criterion: The XLSX contains a row or record for each of the six linked cases and no extra linked-case row created by the duplicate.
original.grader_hint: Compare unique incident identifiers and source-defined cancellation keys.

criteria.description: XLSX 保留源帐户标识符和事件时间戳，而不将它们转换为不相关的发明标识符。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查每个显示的帐户和时间戳。

original.criterion: The XLSX preserves the source account identifiers and event timestamps without converting them into unrelated invented identifiers.
original.grader_hint: Check every displayed account and timestamp.

criteria.description: XLSX 中不可用或不可计算的值明显不同于数字零。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查零分母行和任何其他源指定的不可用值。

original.criterion: Unavailable or non-calculable values in the XLSX are visibly distinct from numeric zero.
original.grader_hint: Inspect the zero-denominator row and any other source-designated unavailable values.

criteria.description: 该数据包适合内部流通：条理清晰，足够简洁，便于审阅，并且没有令人分心、未经证实的猜测。
criteria.evidence: 将数据包作为一个整体进行渲染。
criteria.grader_hint: 评估博蒙特上尉和跨职能审阅者的实际可用性，包括标题、导航和明确的限制。

original.criterion: The packet is suitable for internal circulation: organized, concise enough to review, and free of distracting unsupported speculation.
original.grader_hint: Assess practical usability for Capt. Beaumont and cross-functional reviewers, including headings, navigation, and clear limitations.

criteria.description: 数据包和索引在六个链接事件的来源计数和不同的比较帐户计数上达成一致。
criteria.evidence: 跨 DOCX/PDF/XLSX 和源的汇总指标。
criteria.grader_hint: 重复数据删除后重新计算源的两个计数并比较所有可交付成果。

original.criterion: The packet and index agree on the source-derived count of six linked incidents and the distinct comparison-account count.
original.evidence: Summary metrics across DOCX/PDF/XLSX and source.
original.grader_hint: Recompute both counts from the source after de-duplication and compare all deliverables.

spec.professional_context: Sablefield County Sheriff's Office is conducting an internal review of six commercial burglary reports associated with Halcyon Alarm & Monitoring. The packet is intended for supervisory review and possible referral to the District Attorney, using only supplied reports, interview material, and vendor records.
difficulty_sources: Join six previously separate burglary narratives to Halcyon operator-cancel records
Distinguish the six linked premises from Halcyon accounts with cancels but no reported loss
Recognize and disclose a stale helper field, overlapping duplicate records, and a zero-denominator convention
Present the relationship clearly enough for a cold reader and a prosecutorial review

semantic_content: Create six complete commercial burglary report narratives from Sablefield County, each with a synthetic incident identifier, premise name, report date, loss window, no-forced-entry finding, reported loss description, and a source reference.

Use Glassmere Components and Wrenfield Works as two of the six premises. Use the supplied world names for Sablefield County Sheriff's Office, Halcyon Alarm & Monitoring, Sgt. Desmond Iwuchukwu, and Capt. Solange Beaumont.

Provide a Halcyon cancellation log containing the six incident-linked accounts and operator user-cancel events occurring within ninety minutes of the corresponding loss windows. Include account identifiers, premise/account labels, event timestamps, operator wording, and a stable cancellation-record key.

Provide Halcyon's broader comparison material showing other accounts with user cancels and no reported loss, including enough account and event information to identify the comparison population without external knowledge.

Include interview or stakeholder notes that are factual and source-faithful, such as the deputies' original unrelated-case dispositions and the vendor record description, without resolving the investigative significance for the solver.

State source-level record identifiers and key definitions in ordinary field documentation: report rows are identified by incident identifier, cancellation rows by cancellation-record key, and the account comparison rows by account identifier plus comparison-period label. These definitions make the de-duplication key observable without supplying a linkage conclusion.

Include a compact source-defined rate or ratio table relevant to the comparison material. At least one row must have a denominator of zero and no convention for handling it. The source must not prescribe whether the resulting value should be blank, NA, or another representation.

Include exactly one retired helper column in the cancellation or comparison data. Label it as retired in the source, populate it with stale values that conflict with the current record relationships, and ensure it is not the authoritative field.

Include duplicate or overlapping cancellation rows for at least one of the six linked events. The duplicate rows must share the source-defined cancellation-record key while differing only in repeated or overlapping presentation details, so a defensible packet must avoid counting the event twice.

Seed no other standard layout defects: do not include formula errors, broken references, missing headers, contradictory source facts, hidden image-only graded values, or additional duplicate mechanisms.

transformation.description: The solver should lightly reshape and faithfully cross-reference the supplied prose and tables into a readable investigation packet and a reviewer index. The work is primarily extraction, selection, de-duplication, and clear presentation rather than independent calculation.
required_judgments: Choose and state a defensible treatment for overlapping records while using the source-defined key.
Ignore the retired helper field in favor of current authoritative source fields and disclose that choice.
Choose and state a consistent convention for the zero-denominator rate row.
Distinguish the six linked cases from Halcyon comparison accounts that had cancels without a reported loss.
Use cautious investigative language that describes linkage indicators without asserting unsupported guilt or legal conclusions.

gold_derivation.method: Build a reference packet and index by extracting source facts, retaining one row per source-defined cancellation-record key, excluding the stale helper field from all linkage decisions, and applying a documented non-calculable convention to the zero-denominator row.
relationships: The packet contains exactly six linked incident narratives.
Each linked incident maps to one authoritative Halcyon cancellation event whose timestamp is within ninety minutes of that incident's supplied loss window.
The six linked events cover six distinct premises and six corresponding Halcyon accounts.
The comparison population contains Halcyon accounts with user cancels but no supplied burglary loss and is not counted as part of the six linked cases.
Any repeated cancellation record contributes once when keyed by the source-defined cancellation-record key.
The retired helper column is not used to determine account, incident, timing, or comparison status.
The zero-denominator row is not represented as a fabricated numeric rate; the chosen convention is stated and used consistently in the packet and index.
All incident, account, timestamp, premise, and comparison references agree across DOCX, PDF, and XLSX.

original_instruction:
You are Sgt. Desmond Iwuchukwu preparing the quarterly clearance review for Sablefield County Sheriff's Office. Six commercial burglaries over the past fourteen months were closed separately by deputies as unrelated no-forced-entry losses, but the reports point to Halcyon Alarm & Monitoring and operator-logged user cancellations shortly before each loss. Capt. Solange Beaumont needs a consolidated case linkage packet she can take to the DA, and she needs to be able to see the pattern without already knowing the six cases. Work from `sablefield_halcyon_case_materials.docx`, which contains the six report narratives, the Halcyon cancellation records, account comparison material, and the available interview notes. Prepare `sablefield_consolidated_linkage_packet.docx`, `sablefield_consolidated_linkage_packet.pdf`, and `sablefield_linkage_index.xlsx`, and write all three files into the top level of the working directory where you start, using exactly those filenames. The document packet should give a concise case overview, identify each of the six incidents and the corresponding alarm-account event, set out the factual basis for treating them as one investigative lead, and include a comparison of Halcyon accounts that had cancellation activity without a reported loss. Include a source-faithful chronology or exhibit that lets a reader trace the incident, premises, loss window, account, and cancellation for every linked case. Add a short methods and limitations note explaining how you handled records that overlap, the retired helper field, and any ratio or rate that cannot be calculated; do not turn an unsupported inference into a fact. The spreadsheet is an index for cross-functional reviewers, so keep its incident and account references consistent with the packet and make unresolved or unavailable values visibly distinguishable from zero. Glassmere Components and Wrenfield Works are among the premises in the supplied material, and do not add facts, suspects, motive, or legal conclusions that are not supported there. Keep the packet suitable for internal circulation, preserve the original source wording where a quotation or factual description is used, and make the PDF substantively identical to the DOCX.

---

The files referred to above are in `references/`:

- `references/sablefield_halcyon_case_materials.docx` — Single supplied source containing the six burglary report narratives, Halcyon cancellation log, account comparison material, interview notes, source field definitions, and record identifiers needed to assemble the consolidated linkage packet.

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `sablefield_consolidated_linkage_packet.docx` — The complete written consolidated case linkage packet for supervisory and DA review. (Use only facts supported by the supplied source.; Include overview, six-case linkage presentation, comparison population, chronology or exhibit, methods and limitations, and source references.; Make the treatment of duplicate or overlapping records, the retired helper field, and a zero denominator explicit.; Do not add unsupported suspects, motives, legal conclusions, or invented evidence.)
- `sablefield_consolidated_linkage_packet.pdf` — A rendered PDF version of the consolidated case linkage packet. (Substantively match the DOCX version.; Remain text-searchable and readable when printed or reviewed electronically.; Retain the six-case linkage, comparison population, chronology or exhibit, and methods and limitations note.)
- `sablefield_linkage_index.xlsx` — A reviewer index cross-referencing the six incidents, premises, Halcyon accounts, cancellation events, and packet references. (Use source-faithful incident, premise, account, date, time-window, and cancellation references.; Keep unavailable or not-calculable values distinct from zero.; Match the DOCX and PDF on every incident and account reference.; Include a visible note or field documenting the duplicate, retired-helper, and zero-denominator treatments.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.
